entries.german: Michel von Rosenberg verkauft für 200 fl. sein Achtel am Zehnten zu Hohenstadt und seinen Hof zu Rosenberg an Hans Glaz
entries.english: Michael von Rosenberg sells for 200 florins his one-eighth share of the tithe at Hohenstadt and his farm at Rosenberg to Hans Glaz

facts.content: sold Hans Glaz his eighth share in the tithe at Hohenstadt and his estate at Rosenberg for 200 florins.
